title.en: Konyaku Haki wo Shita Reijou wa Gaman wo Tomemashita
Koi ni Koisuru Koushaku Reijou no Kojirase Renai
Konyaku Haki no Tsugi wa Gisou Konyaku. Sate, Sono Ji wa...
Konyaku Hakisareta no de, Suki ni suru Koto ni Shita.
Konyaku Haki Shita Aite ga Mainichi Shazai ni Kimasu ga, Fukuen Nante Zettai ni Ariemasen!
Doumo, Akuyaku ni Sareta Reijou desukeredo
Kon'yaku Haki o Neratte Kioku Soushitsu no Furi o Shitara, Sokkenai Taido datta Kon'yakusha ga "Kioku o Ushinau Mae no Kimi wa, Ore ni Betabore datta" to Iu, Tondemonai Uso o Tsuki Hajimeta
Higeki no Heroine Buru Imouto no Sei de Konyaku Hakishita no desu ga, Naze ka Seigikan no Tsuyoi Outaishi ni Karamareru you ni narimashita
Outaishi ni Konyaku Haki Saretanode, Mou Baka no Furi wa Yameyou to Omoimasu
Shitataka Reijou wa Dekiaisareru ~Ronpashimasu ga, Konna Watashi Demo yoi desu ka?~
Outaishi Denka wa Koukyuu ni Uranaishi wo Goshomou desu
Nozomarenu Hanayome wa Ichizu ni Koutaishi wo Aisu
Moto Akuyaku Reijo Makimodotta node Ouji-sama kara Tousou Shiyou to Omoimasu!
Imouto ni Konyakusha wo Toraretara Mishiranu Koushaku-sama ni Kyuukonsaremashita
Outaishi-sama, Watashi Kondo Koso Anata ni Korosaretakunain desu!
Enzai Reijou wa Shinjitai - Ginpatsu ga Fukitsu to Iwarete Konyaku Hakisareta Shishaku Reijou wa Ansatsu Kizoku ni Dekiaisarete Daini no Jinsei wo Tannou suru you desu
Konyakusha ni Wasurerareta Watashi Ringoku no Koutaishi Denka to Gisou Konyaku suru Koto ni narimashita (※Tadashi, Denka no Honmei wa Watashi Mitai desu!?)
